description_en: Registers multiple devices under a specified product with randomly generated device names
description_zh: 指定产品下批量注册多个设备（随机生成设备名）
name: BatchRegisterDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>this parameter is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the devices to be registered in batches belong
parameters.help_zh: 要批量注册的设备所隶属的产品ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The number of devices to register.

You can create up to 10,000 devices in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
要注册的设备数量。

单次调用，最多可创建10,000个设备
